rules.family: Acer Aspire / Nitro / Predator / Swift / Spin
rules.technique: Insyde NVRAM VSS / Active Variable Bank Reset
rules.description: Acer exclusively utilizes InsydeH2O UEFI BIOS across almost all consumer and gaming laptops. Passwords and security flags are maintained in the Insyde Variable Storage Subsystem (VSS).
mechanisms: Method 1 (NVRAM Flush): Locate the dirty active NVRAM variable bank containing 'PasswordCheck' and 'AdminPassword'. Erasing this bank to 0xFF forces InsydeH2O upon next cold boot to regenerate pristine NVRAM defaults (Password Disabled).

Method 2 (Clean Factory Update Rebuild): Official Acer update packages (.fd / .bin) contain clean decompressed BIOS volumes without passwords. Technicians inject the user's DMI partition (Serial Number, SNID, UUID, Windows Key) into the clean factory image and flash.

models: Aspire, Nitro, Predator, Swift, Spin, Extensa
rules.description: Preserves Acer 22-character Serial Number (e.g. NXM... / NHM...), 11-digit numeric SNID, Motherboard UUID and Windows OEM license key.
